summary: Frontend multi-page E2E test for Complete Care Hub after refactor to react-router-dom. Verified: homepage 3 brand panels + headline, all navbar routes, all three /practice/:key brand pages (hero, primary, call, facts, directions, website, FAQ accordion expand, CTA + FAQ 'Message this practice' opening slide-over form prefilled with brand), 'More info' panel link -> brand page, blog index (featured + 4 cards), 2 blog post slugs with cover/title/meta/related, invalid routes redirect (/practice/unknown -> /, /blog/unknown-slug -> /blog), scroll resets to top on route change (scrollY=0), homepage Message form opens and POST /api/messages returns 200 with 'Message sent' toast. No console errors observed.

verification.message_form_prefilled_brand: Crescent Medical Centre (when opened from crescent brand-faq-message)

critical_code_review_comments: Layout uses Outlet context {openForm}; BrandPage/Home consume it correctly. Clean.
Minor: BrandPage 'Back to Complete Care' is a plain Link (not routed via router-programmatic scroll) but ScrollToTop covers reset — verified.

MessageForm renders both a shadcn Select trigger (data-testid message-brand) and a hidden native SELECT; the native SELECT is exposed to a11y/screen queries with 3 <option>s — intentional pattern but worth confirming it doesn't double-post; API POST verified single request 200.
Blog data content is inline in blog.js — fine for MVP. Cover image sources are Unsplash/Pexels external URLs; load fine over HTTPS.
No data-testid on BlogIndex root header or BlogPost 'Keep reading' section; not required by spec but could help future tests.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only request; /api/messages verified 200 via UI submission)

seed_data_creation: 1 test message POSTed to /api/messages (name TEST User, contact test@example.com) — may want to purge if cleaning DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All routes and slide-over form flows work. All data-testids listed in review_request are present and functional. Reduced-motion still respected (from iteration_3). No console/page errors during full run.
